description: Read the page, by action: "page" is the semantic snapshot of what is rendered, "find" resolves a locator (testid/role/text/component) to refs you can act on, "… e.g. {"action":"find","by":"testid","value":"submit"}

attrs.description: Attribute NAMES to return per match, e.g. ['href'] for links, ['src'] for images.

audit.description: Also measure the page for what a person would see broken: text cut off with no ellipsis, controls drawn over each other, text under WCAG contrast.

count_only.description: Return just { count } (no element descriptors) — use when you only need "how many match?" and not their refs.

depth.description: Collapse anything deeper than N levels to a size marker — avoids huge outputs for large stores.

diff.description: Return only what changed since your last snapshot of the same scope/mode (mode:delta|unchanged).

ids.description: Add [testid=…] to each control that carries one: a stable identity for a harness mapping the app.

limit.description: Cap descriptors to the first N.

mode.description: full = all elements; interactive = only clickable/focusable elements; status = only route + title.

name.description: Exact accessible-name filter - narrows results when `by` is role and the page has many elements of that role.

ref.description: Element ref (e.g. 'e42') from reticle_look { action: "page" }/reticle_look { action: "find" } — stable until the element leaves the DOM, so no re-snapshot between actions.

scope.description: CSS selector or element ref to restrict the snapshot to a subtree.

self.description: Return the `scope` element ITSELF instead of searching inside it.

sessionId.description: Target a specific tab. Omit unless you mean one — see instructions.

value.description: Query value for the selected strategy (e.g. by=role value=button, or by=testid value=submit-btn).

name: reticle_look
